about.description: CRCD is an exchange traded fund perpetual listed on BingX, tracking T-REX 2X Inverse CRCL Daily Target ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
